resources.string: Draws the liquid ink island around your camera.
Continuum uses this only to draw the island over other apps, around the front camera: playing music, calls, timers and new notifications. It doesn\'t read or collect anything on your screen.
Opens the ink volume panel when you press a volume key.

Continuum uses this only to catch the two volume keys, so they open its volume panel instead of Android\'s. It doesn\'t read or collect anything on your screen; it notes only which app is in front, so the camera keeps its shutter key.
